summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and retail market developments, underscoring regulatory challenges and growth opportunities in India's economy.

bullets.text: Punjab & Haryana High Court quashed the Centre’s complaint against Amazon regarding unmarked toy sales, ruling in favor of the e-commerce giant.
India's micro business credit market has expanded to Rs 29.6 lakh crore, indicating robust growth in small business financing.
Urban India recorded a 13.1% growth in FMCG sales, with traditional trade maintaining an 80% market share, according to recent reports.
Sisley Paris re-entered the Indian market through a partnership with Global SS Beauty Brands, aiming to rank among the top 10 markets in 10 years.
India needs a market capitalization of $50 trillion to sustain a $30 trillion economy, highlighting the scale of economic growth required.
